resolved_findings.title: A raised transport call leaves no structured attempt receipt.
resolved_findings.finding: Each helper calls subprocess.run with timeout=180 before writing its transport_actual JSON. The existing stdout/stderr files survive, but TimeoutExpired or another raised run call skips the receipt entirely. Ordinary nonzero exit handling is correct: its actual returncode is recorded before check_returncode raises. This is a static failure-recording defect under the explicit complete-failure-capture requirement; no timeout of these unexecuted helpers is claimed.
resolved_findings.minimal_fix: Write an ATTEMPT_STARTED receipt containing start time and the exact stdout/stderr paths before subprocess.run. Do not invent an exit code; leave it absent or explicitly unknown. After run returns, overwrite that receipt with the actual completed returncode. No additional try/except, fallback, automatic retry or restart is needed.
resolved_findings.rationale: The explicit review contract requires complete transport failure evidence. A finite timeout is already present in all three sources, so the missing-record branch follows directly from the current code.
resolved_findings.resolution: All three helpers now write ATTEMPT_STARTED before subprocess.run with start time and stdout/stderr paths, omitting exit_code and finished. They overwrite the record as RETURNED only after the call returns and preserve the actual code before check_returncode. Nine isolated fake-only scenarios (timeout, return0, return7 for each helper) confirmed the exact source blocks retain the correct receipt and make one fake call. No try/except, fallback, retry or restart was added.

resolved_findings.title: The short MSVR310 completion node reads the longer RGBNT100 job early.
resolved_findings.finding: The due time is selected by --dataset, but the embedded observer enumerates every child launch/PID and every training directory. At the MSVR310 node it reads RGBNT100 process liveness and epochs.csv before the RGBNT100 completion node. The configured historical estimates are 1895.278 seconds for MSVR310 and 11622.726 seconds for RGBNT100 after their respective starts: about 9727 seconds (2.70 hours) apart for concurrent starts. This defeats the requested per-component observation cadence.
resolved_findings.minimal_fix: Restrict child launch/PID inspection and training progress reads to the selected dataset prefix or exact selected training directory. The original controller liveness/result and selected component receipt may still be read once. Do not change the controller, training schedule or other component deadline.
resolved_findings.rationale: The source contains two concurrently admitted cases with materially different explicitly stored completion estimates. The unfiltered loops deterministically inspect both cases when the earlier selected due time arrives; this is not a hypothetical race.
resolved_findings.resolution: The completion embedded child-launch glob and training-directory glob now use the selected dataset. Both MSVR310 and RGBNT100 instantiations compile; matching against the actual R3 case-derived filenames selects only that dataset. AST comparison confirms these two iterable changes are the only modifications to the remote completion snippet. The original controller result/liveness and selected component receipt remain one observation.
